purpose: single-owner family simulation workspace where one SimulationChoice identity flows from admission record selection through persistence, deep-link restore, print/PDF and module handoff
rules: one simulated volunteer row is one normalized SimulationChoice
majorRecordId is the first canonical admission identity; schoolCode2026 + majorCode2026 is the explicit fallback only when the repository has no record id
standard major code/name never owns admission identity
explicit school selection confirms school immediately
major candidates come only from the confirmed school's actual admission records
the selected major record is stored once and reused for page display, persistence, URL restore and PDF
history is bound to the selected admission record id and each year distinguishes history/missing/loading/error
request failure is never represented as an empty record set
stale worker/network responses cannot overwrite newer user input
family note, source and timestamps remain on the same SimulationChoice
legacy simulation runtimes remain historical assets and are not loaded by the page
PDF/print consumes normalized SimulationChoice data and performs no admission matching
cross-module entries may pass canonical record identity into the same simulation URL contract
mobile layout targets Android 390px, Pad 768px and Desktop 1280px
release revision increments for every simulation code revision
